Laura —

Thanks for flagging. From an accounting/audit perspective we generally prefer issuing a credit memo that references the original invoice (INV-2028-0934). That gives a clear AR trail and keeps our revenue recognition cleaner for recurring billing.

However, classification depends on why we issued the credit: if this is a sales incentive/marketing allowance tied to the pilot, it should be recorded as a contra-revenue / promotion allowance (G/L 6420 - "Sales Promotions / Allowances"). If this is considered a direct refund of billed usage (i.e., billing error), we'd treat it as an AR adjustment reversing the original revenue line (G/L 4000 series).

We need two things from the team before posting:
- An authorized approval (DocuSign link or signed form) or an internal approval chain documented in HubSpot.
- Confirmation of the invoice number to link the credit memo to (customer provided INV-2028-0934, please confirm).

If Aditya/RevOps approve the promotional nature, we'll post as a credit memo referencing the invoice and map to G/L 6420. If it's a billing correction, we'll reverse against the revenue G/L.

Also FYI for audit: keep the nebula_credit_request.pdf and any signed approvals in the deal folder.

Thanks — Ben

P.S. If this is time-sensitive for the customer's month-end close, note the posting window: we can prepare the credit memo this week but it won't hit AR until EOM posting on 08/31 if we want to include it in August close.
